data_dictionary.description: Unique record index for each transaction row
Unique transaction tracking code (e.g., CA-2016-152156)
Date customer placed order (format: MM/DD/YYYY)
Date order was dispatched from fulfillment center
Shipping class: Standard Class, Second Class, First Class, Same Day
Unique alphanumeric customer identifier
Full name of the purchasing customer
Market sector: Consumer, Corporate, Home Office
Country of fulfillment (United States)
City of shipping destination (531 unique cities)
US State (49 distinct states)
US ZIP code for localized delivery
Macro geographic sales division: West, East, Central, South
Unique SKU identifier
Top-level taxonomy: Furniture, Office Supplies, Technology
Granular classification: 17 distinct sub-categories (Chairs, Tables, Phones, etc.)
Full product title/description
Gross transaction revenue in USD ($0.44 to $22,638.48)
Number of units ordered per line item (1 to 14)
Promotional discount applied as a percentage (0.0 to 0.8)
Net earnings/loss generated in USD (-$6,599.98 to +$8,399.98)
